dct_description_sm:
Features related to provincially tracked species and species at risk are not available as open data. Sensitive features are subject to licensing and approvals. Visit the Ontario Ministry of Natural Resources and Forestry website to get access to natural heritage information. 

Mapping the presence and progress of a monitored species subject on the landscape at a specific date, time and location through tracking technologies (e.g. GPS collar). Information collected used in specific species studies and aids in the identification of the occurrence of a species.
